'''Ryland Dackett''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Sith civil war]] of the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He was the [[Shipmaster/Legends|shipmaster]] for the ship [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] in [[Rusher's Brigade]],<ref name="Q&A">{{Faraway|subdomain=blog|url=2011/03/knight-errant-novel-answers-part-i-and.html|text=''Knight Errant'' Q&A|nolive=1}}</ref> and was good friends with [[Jarrow Rusher]]. While he refused to give others his age, he claimed to have been "born during an artillery barrage&mdash;and conceived there, too," and had spent most of his life helping [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] kill other Sith. During the [[Battle of Gazzari]], Dackett took a recovery team to salvage what was left of [[Tun-Badon]]'s [[Serraknife Battalion]], unaware that the entire battalion had been killed. Dackett was injured, but was pulled to safety by the clumsy young [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Beadle Lubboon]].

He had an artificial arm and gapped teeth which often whistled when he talked. He also claimed to have three wives.
